name: debug
description: Codezal-native debugging plugin. Diagnoses broken behavior by evidence, not guesswork — reproduce, isolate, root-cause, fix, regression-test. /debug is a fast triage of a single failure; /debug-deep is a hypothesis-driven root-cause investigation that maps the failure path with Code Map (code_trace/code_callers/code_callees) and proves the fix with a regression test. Project-agnostic: it learns your stack instead of assuming one.
